messages.S1・S2で自分の振動回数を10以上貯め、S3「犯人はあなたですね！」で振動-反: A Tremor team's finisher: build at least 10 of his own Tremor Count through S1 and S2, then use S3 You're the Culprit! to Entangle Tremor - Reverb and trigger Tremor Burst 3 times.
messages.S3の消耗段階: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10消耗してコイン威力が上がる(同期化: **S3's spending tiers**: On use, spends 10 of his own Tremor Count to gain Coin Power (at higher Uptie, at 15 or more it spends 15 for even more). If spent, Coin Ⅰ performs Amplitude Entanglement into Tremor - Reverb, and Coins Ⅱ, Ⅲ, and Ⅳ trigger Tremor Burst 3 times in total. Without spending 10 or more, Coin Ⅲ's Tremor Burst does not occur (Coin Ⅳ's condition differs by Uptie).
messages.振動-反響: 振動爆発時に振動威力の分だけ怠惰ダメージを与える。S3の振動爆発と: **Tremor - Reverb**: On Tremor Burst, deals Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency. Combined with S3's Tremor Bursts, it becomes a damage source.
messages.自分の振動回数の獲得: S1「推理開始」・S2「変形杖護身術」の使用時と的中時に: **Gaining his own Tremor Count**: Increases on use and on hit of S1 Deduction Start and S2 Morph Cane Technique, and above certain amounts, S1 and S2 also gain Coin Power.
messages.敵の振動回数は増やせない: どのスキルにも対象の振動回数を増やす効果はなく、S2: **He cannot increase the enemy's Tremor Count**: None of his skills increase the target's Tremor Count, and S2's and S3's Tremor Bursts actually reduce it by 1. Allies need to inflict the Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「振動癒着変形戦闘杖(未認可発明品)」(怠惰×6・保有・同期化Ⅱで: **Combat passive — Vibroweld Morph-combat Cane (Unauthorized Invention) (6 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Grants Damage Up next turn equal to the number of Tremor Bursts he triggered that turn, up to 3.
messages.自分への振動爆発: 振動回数を消耗できなかったとき(同期化段階が高いと、消耗が1: **Tremor Burst on himself**: If he could not spend Tremor Count (at higher Uptie, if he spent less than 15), he also triggers Tremor Burst on himself at the end of S3. Tremor Burst shifts the Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency, so if he has no Tremor himself, the impact is likely small.
messages.敵の振動回数を増やせる味方と組み、S1・S2で自分の振動回数を貯める。回数が10: Pair him with allies who can increase the enemy's Tremor Count, and build his own Tremor Count with S1 and S2. Once it reaches 10 or more, use S3 to entangle into Tremor - Reverb and gain Stagger Threshold shift and Sloth damage from 3 Tremor Bursts. S2 itself also has high power, so attack with S2 while waiting for Tremor to be ready.
